meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 它会先追问你想改什么,再按需帮 NanoClaw 加新渠道、接 MCP 工具、改触发规则或助手人设;能用现成专用技能就先用,改完告诉你怎么重启用。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加渠道(如 Telegram、Slack、邮件)、改触发规则或加其他集成与定制时接管。

say.text: 帮我加上 Telegram 作为输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个 agent group、是否独立

say.text: 改一下某个 agent group 的人设和回复风格
给这个 agent group 接一个 Gmail 的 MCP 工具

howto.what_en: It first asks what you want to change, then helps add channels, wire MCP integrations, tweak triggers or assistant persona in NanoClaw, preferring existing dedicated skills, and tells you how to restart.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, email), change triggers, add integrations, or make other NanoClaw customizations.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel for me
say_en.note: It asks which agent group to reach

say_en.text: Change one agent group's persona and reply style
Wire a Gmail MCP tool into this agent group
